label: Lucius - GoDaddy Pull
info:
Runs every 15 minutes. Pulls full incidents/daily_logs/therapy_sessions from GoDaddy's api/pull_manual_data.php, writes structured fields to InfluxDB for correlation, archives the FULL raw response to local disk for disaster recovery (restorable via WardStock's existing import.php — see PLAN.md §4), logs job start/finish to InfluxDB, updates HA status entities.

UNTESTED — same caveat as the Oura Sync flow. Verify the schedule trigger and http request node configs against your actual Node-RED version after import.

Callable (Aug 2026, full_sync_flow.json) — n_gd_link_in is an additional entry point feeding the exact same first node (n_gd_read_secrets_file) the '15 minutes' inject already uses, so calling it via Link Call is identical to a normal scheduled run. n_gd_link_out_done fires (mode: return) right after the job's own success/failure is determined and logged, i.e. Full Sync doesn't block waiting on the async InfluxDB/SQLite bookkeeping writes that follow — those still happen, just not on the caller's critical path.

name: Load secrets + start job log
Prepare pull_manual_data request
Split: InfluxDB write + local archive
Prepare InfluxDB batch write
Prepare archive write
Log success + update HA status
Log failure + update HA status
Prepare finish-point write
SQLite: ensure job_status table exists
sqlite: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS
SQLite: prep status UPSERT
